This document outlines the visual inspection activities I1, to be performed on
an annually bases Y1 as indicated in the above title block. The 1st draft
initiated by Demo substation, eng. Abd Eltawab Ramadan from ME. The first review 
at Nov. 2007

items:
Safety fence 
 with caution marks surrounding the work area.

CB must be
 isolated and proper earthing at the two sides of CB is required.

Interrupt
 remote control and motor circuits (this achieved by receiving the multi-pin
 plug at the left hand side at the operating mechanism)

Switch breaker
 ON and OFF manually in order to discharge the closing and springs.

Determine the SF6
 gas pressure with the plug-in manometer and compare
 with value from the gas pressure curve-top-up with SF6 gas if the pressure has dropped to about the
 level of tapping-up (refilling) pressure.

Trip dash-pot
 (damper); check the oil level in the dash pot with the piston in the
 "OFF" position. If there are traces of oil at the top end of the
 dash pot the dash pot must be replaced.

Read the 
 operating counter read-off and record the number of switching operations.

Tools and Equipments

Read the
